normativeObservations: The ordinary entity field sequence starts at group 70 flags and includes version/flag-gated optional fields.
For R2000+, the first vertex is 2RD and subsequent X/Y coordinates are DD values relative to the previous point.
Bulges, R2010+ vertex identifiers, and widths are separate conditional arrays.
The modeler subentity begins with an RL byte count followed by a B byte block excluding common entity data.
The B block is described as starting at LWPOLYLINE flags (BS) and ending at the width array (BD).
Three RC fields follow and are each labeled unknown byte.
This wrapper description does not specify the embedded block's complete AC1027 field encoding or explain the observed non-byte suffix.
